CCQ.analytic_caveat: The stated admissible beta condition cannot supply a common unit-response bound for every printed branch: lambdaTilde=1,beta=1/4 is allowed, yet printed mid filter atlambda=2 equals−2. This is a scoped algebraic check, not a full theory/code audit.
CCQ.closest_relation: Recent direct learned structural-filter/gated-single ancestry; no persistent predictive-member loss, independent ensemble comparison or ensemble-specific correction criterion established in these scopes.
CCQ.single_control: A complete quadratic basis with equally capable channel maps and node gate can express all scoped operations. Sharing/private copies of cutoff parameters does not invent the filter bank.
CCQ.training_protocol_scope: §3.1 describes semi-supervised node classification,60/20/20 random non-stratified splits and equivalent Optuna search budgets. It lists GCN/GAT,JK-Net/GCNII,H2GCN/FAGCN/BernNet/EvenNet/JacobiConv/LHKGNN. These are reported protocol choices, not certified baseline competence or adopted results.
CCQ.verified_method: Normalized undirected Laplacian; low/mid/high/identity quadratic filter channels built from X,LX,L²X; learnable cutoff proxy and magnitude parameters; channel-specific feature maps and nodewise softmax gating before activation. Algorithm1 gives convex/concave branches via if statements, without resolving their selection implementation in this scope.

DSF.analytic_caveat: Displayed recurrence uses L with spectrum[0,2], so the usual bounded Chebyshev-on[−1,1] property cannot be assumed: T3(2)=26. This is not a claim the paper states that bound; no stability theorem is transferred.
DSF.closest_relation: Recent time-evolving graph-filter coefficients are prior; static-task private-filter/gauge novelty is not supported.
DSF.conditioning: Recurrent filter branch receives normalized snapshot time only. Graph structure enters each snapshot basis; it is not a graph-error-conditioned recurrent state in the displayed construction.
DSF.protocol_limit: §4.6/§5 explicitly disclose snapshot/event baseline sampler differences, one adopted seed for converged runs and unequal epoch semantics. No cross-family superiority or cost normalization is adopted.
DSF.single_control: At each observed prefix, coefficients mix a complete same Chebyshev bank. A single bank with the same recurrent-state/gating functions reproduces the scoped forward operation; copying private states is an ensemble of that existing operator module.
DSF.verified_method: Causal observed-prefix snapshot graph, projected features, raw normalized-Laplacian Chebyshev recurrence, channel-wise/order-wise coefficients, ReLU, recurrent coefficient state, multiplicative global/order evolution gates and concatenating link decoder with item embeddings. BCE jointly trains modules.
